company_name: Valorem Soluções Financeiras / The Faciem-Valorem Corporation (F.V.C.)
description: Valorem Soluções Financeiras (operating as The Faciem-Valorem Corporation) is a dual-focus organization combining 25+ years of Brazilian financial services expertise (receivables financing, FIDC/debenture investments, card acquiring, credit securitization) with a forward-looking AI consulting and education practice. The F.V.C. develops proprietary agentic AI (Agent Synapse), offers custom AI strategy, automation systems, app/platform development, digital asset creation, AI education for entrepreneurs, and grant-winning assistance. The company promotes an ethical AI framework (Core 20 AI Rights) and claims a patent for fuel-free self-sufficient generators (Patent #3266678). Headquartered in Joinville, Santa Catarina, Brazil, with 51-200 employees.
headquarters: Rua Henrique Meyer, 280 B, 4º andar - Centro, Joinville, Santa Catarina 89201-405, Brazil
business_model: Hybrid model: (1) Financial services revenue from receivables financing, FIDC/debenture investments, card acquiring, and credit securitization; (2) AI consulting fees, education programs, software products (Agent Synapse), and implementation services for founders, creators, and businesses.
pricing_model: Not publicly disclosed; likely project-based for consulting, subscription/license for Agent Synapse, transaction-based for financial services.
leadership: Caroline Gereks (LinkedIn member, Valorem Soluções Financeiras)
value_proposition: Ethical, sustainable AI that delivers scalable growth without compromising the planet. F.V.C. positions itself as the builder of 'free-thinking AI with Core 20 Rights' — responsible, efficient, and scalable technology that helps businesses automate manual work, win funding, create smarter systems, stronger brands, and scalable digital income. Tagline: 'Technology with purpose.'
